blocks.text: Andrea Brillantes says her partner’s wealth does not matter to her as she is already financially stable and can provide for herself. During her guest appearance on “Fast Talk with Boy Abunda” on Friday, Oct. 30, the actress was asked whether having a wealthy partner was “important” for her. “Sa totoo lang, ang importante sa akin ay masipag, hindi mayaman,” she stressed.
